title: Fairness or Fluency? An Investigation into Language Bias of Pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring accuracy disparities and option selection preferences across 15 languages in same-language and inter-language pairwise LLM-as-a-judge settings using the multilingual MMMLU dataset.

Calculating masked perplexities of synthesized, style-fused answers and using linear regression and nested F-tests to determine if model preference disparities are driven by perplexity differences (fluency/familiarity) rather than language identity.
